case: MySQL ENUM and SET parser/keyed edit across SQL modes
contract: Grid parsing validates values against the declared ENUM/SET members, including apostrophe and backslash metadata, and refuses unknown labels or members.
Bound keyed edits preserve ENUM label bytes and a multi-member SET mask under default, NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES, ANSI_QUOTES and combined SQL modes.
Blank input retains shared SQL NULL/required-field behavior, while explicit `''` selects an empty ENUM label or the empty SET value; native ordinals/masks distinguish empty values from NULL.
The native server control demonstrates that permissive mode otherwise coerces an unknown ENUM label to its error value and drops an unknown SET member; the control updates are rolled back.
An untouched sibling row retains its native ordinals, masks and label bytes in every mode.

MariaDB 11 reports the declared ENUM/SET members in column metadata; valid apostrophe/backslash values bind and retain their native ordinals, masks and bytes in the same four modes, while invalid labels and members are refused.

parser_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --lib value_contract_mysql_enum_and_set_parser_preserves_labels -- --test-threads=1

mysql_keyed_edit.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --lib value_contract_mysql_enum_set_keyed_edits_preserve_native_values_across_sql_modes -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

mariadb_keyed_edit.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --lib value_contract_mariadb_enum_set_grid_edit_preserves_values_across_sql_modes -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

app_library_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --lib -- --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: SQL modes beyond the four tested values remain open.
This case does not close B3 or qualify the 0.2.0 release.
